s.note: the green flubber bouncing around the lab
s.how: Blitz 2 avocados with 200g thawed peas, the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint and 100g feta until smooth and very green. Cut pita bread into wedges, brush with oil and bake until crisp. Serve the goo with the crisps and some sugar snap peas.

Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour until smooth, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time. Stir in 100g grated cheddar and a pinch of paprika. Pipe small balls onto trays and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow.

m.note: Sara waiting at the altar while he works
m.how: Rub 4 chicken breasts with lemon juice, thyme, oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 20 minutes with 800g halved baby potatoes started 20 minutes earlier. Steam green beans and toss everything with butter. The dinner he should have been at, three times over.

w.how: Make up 3 packets of lime jelly with a little less water than the packet says so it holds its shape. Pour into a ring mould and chill overnight. Dip the mould briefly in hot water and turn out wobbling onto a plate. Fill the centre with cream and sliced kiwifruit.

d.note: the green glow in the lab
d.how: Pour a splash of lime cordial into tall glasses and top with cold lemonade. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it floats and foams up green. Serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw before it bubbles over like an experiment.
